record.name: WhatsApp Business
record.one_liner: The WhatsApp Business Platform provides enterprise-grade APIs (Cloud API, Business Management API, and Marketing Messages API) for businesses to programmatically send messages, manage accounts, and handle customer conversations.

auth.notes: Uses bearer access tokens (system tokens or business tokens) passed in the Authorization header.

access.notes: Developers can sign up and use developer tools/embedded signup, but certain partner solutions and advanced onboarding require business verification, solution partner processes, or credit line setup.

api_surface.notes: Uses HTTP REST requests built on the Graph API and delivers JSON payloads via webhooks.

mcp.notes: WhatsApp Business Tools MCP allows setting up and managing WhatsApp business from an AI agent.

buildability.reasoning: Access requires setting up Meta developer accounts and obtaining system or business access tokens via embedded signup flows, while the Cloud API and webhooks are thoroughly documented.

evidence.claim: The WhatsApp Business Platform provides Cloud API, Marketing Messages API, and Business Management API for messaging and account management.
The platform uses the HTTP protocol and Graph API, relying heavily on webhooks for message updates and delivery statuses.
Announced WhatsApp Business Tools MCP for setting up and managing WhatsApp business from an AI agent.
